overview: The Ascendant Causeway is Ka Vethan’s grand ceremonial approach, connecting the Outer Gates to the Praesertum Forum.
history: Constructed during the founding era of Ka Vethan to symbolize ascension into Akhevan governance.
Reinforced with void‑arcane stabilizers after early resonance instability.
Used for Praesertum processions, military marches, and civic ceremonies.
Expanded to support increased traffic during Akhevan territorial consolidation.
Modern Causeway remains the primary artery into the city’s political core.
hooks: A resonance pylon destabilizes along the Causeway.
A Praesertum procession requires additional security.
An Akhevan patrol reports anomalous void signatures.
A structural stabilizer fails during peak traffic.
